stem: Calculate the first coordinate of the image of $v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$ under $T(v)=Av$, where $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\3&4\end{pmatrix}$.

Calculate the determinant of $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}$ and hence decide whether its transformation has an inverse. Enter the determinant.
State what $\det A=0$ means for a two-dimensional transformation.

options.A: Orientation reverses but area is unchanged.
options.B: Areas collapse to zero and no inverse exists.
options.C: Areas are unchanged and the inverse is $A$.
